itinerary_upload.destinations_help: Destinations — edit anything that's wrong. Only stops we can place on the map (📍✓) will show up in your Itinerary Tracker and safety checks.
itinerary_upload.intro: Upload a PDF, Word (.docx), text file, or a photo/scan (jpg, png) of your itinerary and we'll pull out your destinations, hotels, and transport automatically. A blurry or handwritten photo may not read perfectly — you can always fix anything wrong on the next screen.
itinerary_upload.locate_tooltip: No location found for this stop yet — tap to try to locate it
itinerary_upload.no_destinations: No destinations found — add one, or type your itinerary in the Plan tab manually.
itinerary_upload.reading_document: Reading your document… photos can take up to a minute.
itinerary_upload.save_failed: Could not save your itinerary. Please try again.
itinerary_upload.unresolved_warning_one: ⚠ {{count}} stop couldn't be placed on the map, so it's not showing in your Itinerary Tracker yet — upload again and use "📍 Locate" to fix that.
itinerary_upload.unresolved_warning_other: ⚠ {{count}} stops couldn't be placed on the map, so they're not showing in your Itinerary Tracker yet — upload again and use "📍 Locate" to fix that.
itinerary_upload.upload_timeout: This is taking too long. Try a smaller/clearer photo, or a PDF/DOCX/text file instead.
